entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's really a fit issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats several times, but after any ride over an hour, they're giving me painful blisters on my heels. They just don't seem to be the right shape for my foot.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters can definitely ruin a ride. I understand completely. Let me pull up your account to get the process started. Can I have your email address?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered 37 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

That's a relief, thank you. I do appreciate you honoring that. Since I am a VIP member and will have to go through the hassle of boxing these up and shipping them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? I was planning on buying a different pair from your site.

That's a reasonable request. I do see you're a long-time VIP member, and we want to make sure you get gear that works for you. Yes, I can certainly do that. As a courtesy, I'll add a 20% discount coupon directly to your account once we finish this call. You can use it anytime in the next six months.
Oh, 20% is fantastic. That's more than I was expecting. Thank you, David, that's excellent service.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed you the prepaid return label. Just print it out and attach it to the original box. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method. The coupon is active on your account now. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
